clue.text: Furniture right up to date

parts.note: a sofa is a piece of furniture

explanation.surface: A description of furniture that is fashionably modern.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up to date' here means 'until now', not 'modern'.
explanation.definitionFit: Until now, as in 'no problems up to date', is the sense of this two-word phrase.

clue.text: Does help, with rewriting, to hold fine pen

indicators.note: to hold means the rearranged letters wrap around another piece
rewriting means the letters of the words are written out again in a new order

parts.note: taken as written, the plural of doe
taken as written
F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Someone helps with redrafting and holds a good writing pen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pen' looks like a writing tool but is an animal enclosure; 'Does' are female deer here, not the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheepfold is an enclosure for keeping sheep, a type of pen.

clue.text: One side of emerald, in truth

definitions.text: One side of emerald, in truth

indicators.note: in means the letter goes inside the word for truth

parts.note: a fact is a truth

indicators.note: one side of a word here is its opening edge, its first letter

explanation.surface: A remark that this really is one face of a gemstone.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay: 'One side of' gives E from emerald, put 'in' FACT.
explanation.definitionFit: A cut gemstone has many flat faces, each called a facet.

clue.text: Type who adheres to the crown — in a way, an obstacle to progress

definitions.text: Type who adheres to the crown — in a way
definitions.meaning: a driver who sticks to the raised centre, the crown, of a highway
someone who blocks other traffic from getting past

explanation.definitionFit: A selfish motorist who hogs the middle of the carriageway blocks other traffic.

clue.text: Have fine prospects lay siege to blonde

parts.note: to beset a place is to surround and attack it
fair hair is blonde hair

explanation.surface: An ambitious suitor with good prospects besieges a blonde woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Weather that is settled fine is said to be this, so the phrase means looking promising.

clue.text: Prominent woman joined one union after another

parts.note: big means prominent or important
Amy is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A well-known woman marries repeatedly.
explanation.definitionFit: Bigamy is the offence of marrying while already married, entering a second marriage.

clue.text: Tooth, extremely sharp, used on salad ingredient

indicators.note: extremely asks for the extremes, the first and last letters, of the word sharp

parts.note: rocket is a peppery salad leaf

explanation.surface: A sharp tooth is used to bite into salad leaves.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'used on' places SP above ROCKET.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprocket is a tooth on a wheel that engages a chain.

clue.text: They salvage things from rocks

definitions.meaning: totting is collecting saleable scrap, so these are rag-and-bone collectors
to rock is to sway unsteadily, as a verb in the third person

explanation.surface: Scavengers pick useful objects off a rocky shore.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'totter' is British slang for a rag-and-bone man who salvages scrap.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun is scavengers of junk; the verb means wobbles or sways.

clue.text: Entrance a teacher with girl I introduced

indicators.note: introduced means put into, so the girl and I go inside the teacher

parts.note: a don is a university teacher
a miss is a girl or young woman

explanation.surface: A lecturer brings a young woman in and introduces her.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Entrance' looks like the verb to enchant; it is the noun meaning entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Admission means the right of entry, or being allowed in.

clue.text: Gas attack in progress, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals that the phrase is to be pronounced rather than spelt

parts.note: a raid on is an assault under way

explanation.surface: A gas attack is under way, according to reports.
explanation.definitionFit: Radon is a radioactive noble gas.

clue.text: Being fair, one's not a robber

definitions.text: Being fair, one's not a robber

parts.words: Being fair, one's not a robber
parts.note: a money-changer who deals fairly swaps currency rather than robbing customers; also one who is no longer a short-changer

explanation.definitionFit: A dealer who trades one currency for another honestly is a fair trader of money, not a thief.

clue.text: Return most of fabric that's shrinking

indicators.note: return asks for the shortened word to be sent back the other way
most of drops the final letter of the fabric word

parts.note: dimity is a light cotton fabric

explanation.surface: Someone sends back a piece of cloth that has shrunk in the wash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' trims DIMITY to DIMIT, and 'Return' turns it round. 'shrinking' looks like a property of the fabric but means shy.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrinking violet is a shy, nervous person, so shrinking means fearful.

clue.text: Stage satirical act? Stop!

definitions.meaning: read cryptically, to put on a show of mockers, i.e. stage a satire
an exclamation meaning to thwart or put an end to something

explanation.surface: A theatre director is told to halt a satirical performance.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to jinx or frustrate a plan, bringing it to a halt.

clue.text: Irritated, being marginalised?

definitions.meaning: literally sitting at the border or rim of something

explanation.surface: Someone pushed to the margins becomes annoyed.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means nervous or tense, and literally means placed at the rim.

clue.text: As clan head, I ordered food from Mexico

indicators.note: ordered means put into a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A Scottish chieftain orders a Mexican dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordered' suggests ordering food; it signals that CLAN HEAD I is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: An enchilada is a Mexican rolled tortilla with filling.

clue.text: Hard worker's success, finally earning crust

parts.note: the bee is the proverbial busy, hard worker, with 's as a possessive giving S
a win is a success

indicators.note: finally picks the final letter of the word earning

explanation.surface: A diligent labourer's achievement eventually earns their daily bread.
explanation.walkthrough: 'earning crust' suggests earning a living; the crust is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Beeswing is the filmy deposit or crust that forms in old port wine.

clue.text: Christian reader's dismissal of sorcerer?

parts.note: 'Go!' is an order of dismissal
humorously, a speller is one who casts spells

explanation.surface: A church lector ordering a wizard to leave.
explanation.walkthrough: In church a gospeller reads the Gospel at a communion service.
explanation.definitionFit: A gospeller is the one who reads the Gospel in a church service.

clue.text: Prayer in which a verse needing musical setting holds me up

indicators.note: holds means the verse and setting surround another piece

parts.note: an aria is a song set for solo voice

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word is read upwards, from bottom to top

explanation.surface: A prayer whose verses are being set to music lifts me.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' means the word reads from bottom to top, and 'holds' places it between the verse letter and the song.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ave Maria is the Hail Mary, a Catholic devotional prayer.

clue.text: Heartlessly deceive, admitting one's resolute

indicators.note: admitting means letting something in, so one piece goes inside the other
heartlessly removes the central letter of the word deceive

parts.note: one is I, and 's is read as 'is', giving I and S

explanation.surface: A heartless cheat confesses to being firm-minded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heartlessly' removes the central E, leaving DECIVE, which 'admitting' then opens to take the two letters in after its third letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A firm, determined person who settles things quickly is decisive.

clue.text: Work at Billingsgate, say, is out for Number One

indicators.note: say signals that the phrase is spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: Billingsgate is London's famous fish market, where traders sell fish

explanation.surface: A fishmonger's job at London's fish market is all about self-interest.
explanation.definitionFit: Being out for Number One means looking after oneself first, the mark of an egotist.

clue.text: Son given lots of ice-cream and cakes

parts.note: ice-cream is served in cones, so lots of servings are cones

explanation.surface: A boy is treated to plenty of ice-cream and baked treats.
explanation.definitionFit: Scones are small baked teatime goods, a kind of cake.

clue.text: Taken into consideration through delicacy

indicators.note: taken into means one word is placed inside another

parts.note: care is thoughtfulness or consideration
via means by way of, through

explanation.surface: Something is considered thoroughly with tact.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Taken into consideration' reads as a stock phrase, but splits into the indicator and CARE. 'delicacy' is food, not tact.
explanation.definitionFit: Caviare (sturgeon roe) is a luxury food, a classic gourmet treat.

clue.text: Speed 'of' light beam absorbed physicist

indicators.note: absorbed means taken in, so one letter sits inside the beam

parts.note: a plank is a long wooden beam
c is the physics symbol for the speed of light

explanation.surface: A light beam's speed is taken in by a scientist.
explanation.definitionFit: Max Planck was the German founder of quantum theory.

clue.text: Nagging conscience, as result of abandoning singing lessons?

definitions.meaning: the inner voice of conscience, a phrase from the Bible

definitions.text: as result of abandoning singing lessons?
definitions.meaning: humorously, a voice that stayed weak and quiet because training stopped

explanation.surface: Giving up voice training leaves a guilty feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical phrase from Kings is the quiet inner prompting of conscience.

clue.text: Steady, being secured by ropes, say

indicators.note: say signals that the word is to be pronounced

parts.note: a mast is stayed when held by stays, supporting ropes

explanation.surface: Something tied down by ropes stays firm.
explanation.definitionFit: Staid means sober, settled and steady in character.

clue.text: Lazy examiner tested only a part

indicators.note: only a part signals that the answer is a stretch inside these words

explanation.surface: An idle invigilator marked only some of the paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Inert means sluggish and inactive, without energy.

clue.text: Computing devices wired up to a main frame for digital operation

definitions.text: Computing devices wired up to a main frame for digital operation

parts.words: Computing devices wired up to a main frame for digital operation
parts.note: sounds like computers, but means counting frames of beads on wires, worked by the fingers

explanation.definitionFit: Counting frames with beads strung on wires were the earliest calculators, operated by fingers or digits.

clue.text: Look familiar, as leper used to

definitions.meaning: to seem known, to stir a memory
medieval lepers carried a bell to warn people of their approach

explanation.surface: A face seems familiar, like a leper's warning.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to evoke a memory; lepers literally sounded bells as a warning.

clue.text: The final impression one may make

definitions.text: The final impression one may make

parts.words: The final impression one may make
parts.note: not a lasting reputation but a plaster cast taken of a face after death

explanation.definitionFit: A cast taken of a dead person's face is a last impression in the moulding sense.

clue.text: Jonathan, for one, is not a fast follower

definitions.meaning: Jonathan is a variety of apple grown for eating raw
someone who does not keep a fast, i.e. one who consumes food

explanation.surface: A man named Jonathan refuses to observe a religious fast.
explanation.definitionFit: A dessert apple is called this, and so is anyone who consumes food rather than fasting.
